AppliesTo.description: Who a policy rule applies to.

AuthorshipMode.description: The authorship mode of a repo.

CommitFormat.description:
`policies.commitFormat`: the first line of the message follows Conventional Commits 1.0.0
(`type(scope)!: description`, a blank line before any body). The messages Git writes
(merge commits, `Revert "…"`, `fixup!`/`squash!`/`amend!`) do not break it; `{}` already asks
for the format.

appliesTo.description: `agents` (default): only detected or registered agents; `everyone`: also the person.

types.description:
From 1 to 32 types of `[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}`; an invalid one is dropped alone, and if all
are dropped no type is accepted. Without it, the eleven of `config-conventional`.

DiffSize.description:
`policies.diffSize`: the most lines (added plus deleted) one commit may change. A binary file
counts 0, a submodule 1 per side, a mode change 0, an exact rename 0 and a rename with edits
its edited lines; line endings and whitespace count. `exclude` removes paths from the count
of this rule only: a personal level or the worktree cannot exempt the team's rule. With
`appliesTo: everyone` the person cannot make a large direct commit either, and there is no
conscious exception for a direct commit.

appliesTo.description: `agents` (default): only detected or registered agents; `everyone`: also the person.

exclude.description:
At most 64 path patterns of at most 256 bytes, as `forbiddenPaths`. An invalid one is
dropped alone.

maxLines.description: Required, from 1 to 100 000. Without it the rule does not exist.

baseBranch.description:
Base branch of the repository. Only read from the copy of the main branch, and only
effective once confirmed by the developer (ADR-GRD-004 § 3).

gitPath.description: Absolute path to the Git executable.

idleThresholdMinutes.description: Minutes without activity before a session is idle.

powerSaving.description:
Power saving: `auto` (default) saves on battery or in low power mode, `on` always,
`off` never (ADR-GRP-015 § 2).

Observation.description:
`engine.observation` section: when an observed repo goes dormant and how
its safety nets run. Never at the team level.

dormantAfterHours.description: Hours without activity before a repo goes dormant.

dormantPollSeconds.description: Interval of the metadata sweep of the dormant repos, in seconds.

dormantReconcileMinutes.description:
Shortest interval of the slow reconciliation of a dormant repo, in
minutes; the CPU budget may make it longer.

OnAgentCommit.description: What `human-author` does with an agent's commit.

PatternPolicy.description:
`policies.protectedBranches` and `policies.forbiddenPaths`: a list of patterns and who they
apply to. A branch pattern matches the whole short name (`release/*` does not cover
`release/1.0/x`; `release/**` does). A path pattern follows `.gitignore`, reduced: with no
`/` apart from a trailing one it is found at any depth (`secrets/`, `*.pem`), with a `/`
in the middle or at the start it is anchored to the root (`config/prod.yml`, `/secrets`),
and a directory covers what is below it. No negations (`!`) and no comments (`#`). With
`appliesTo: everyone` the person is held too and, with no conscious exception in the MVP,
a protected branch is frozen for local pulls and fast-forwards as well.

appliesTo.description: `agents` (default): only detected or registered agents; `everyone`: also the person.

patterns.description:
At most 64 patterns of at most 256 bytes. An invalid one (empty, with control bytes,
starting with `!` or `#`, or a branch written as `refs/heads/…`) is dropped alone.

Permissions.description: `permissions` section: a permission for each governed operation.

allow.description: Operations allowed. Only the copy of the main branch can relax.

ask.description: Operations that need the developer's confirmation (denied while there is no queue).

disableSafeMinimum.description:
Turn off the safe minimum (deny force-push and the deletion of the base branch).
Only effective from the confirmed copy of the main branch (ADR-GRD-003 § 2, D6).

Policies.description: `policies` section. Open: its keys arrive with their stories.

commitAuthorship.description:
Who makes the commits (US-GRD-018, BR-AUTH-005). Only the floor relaxes it to
`flexible` (Q-GRD-20).

commitFormat.description:
Format of the commit message (US-GRD-009, BR-VAL-003). One format rules: the first level
that declares it, from the floor down to the personal levels.

diffSize.description:
Limit of changed lines per commit (US-GRD-009, BR-VAL-003). Every level that declares it
brings its own rule; the commit must meet all of them.

forbiddenPaths.description: Paths a commit cannot touch (US-GRD-008, BR-VAL-003). Only adds protection.

protectedBranches.description:
Branches that cannot be moved (US-GRD-008, BR-VAL-003). Only adds protection: every
level's patterns apply.

PolicyEffect.description: What a broken `diffSize` or `commitFormat` rule does.

storeQuotaGB.description: Quota of the snapshot store, in GB.

degradedPollSeconds.description: Polling interval in degraded mode, in seconds.

description:
One settings document: `.gitraptor/settings.json` (team), `settings.json` (profile) or
`settings.local.json` (local). Strict JSON, no comments.

$schema.description: URL of the published schema, for editors. Never downloaded.

permissions.description: Permission of each governed operation (ADR-GRD-003, BR-VAL-002).

policies.description:
Repository policies (ADR-GRD-003). `commitAuthorship` (US-GRD-018) is the first key;
US-GRD-008, US-GRD-009 and US-GRD-015 add others.

title: GitRaptor settings
